# Faire

> > Faire is a wholesale marketplace connecting independent retailers with emerging and established brands across categories including home goods, fashion, food, beauty, and artisan products.

Faire enables small businesses to discover and purchase wholesale products from diverse suppliers, featuring values-based shopping options and supporting independent brands. The platform showcases thousands of brands ranging from handmade ceramics and organic skincare to sustainable fashion and artisan foods.

## Key Topics

- Wholesale marketplace
- Independent retailers
- Brand profiles
- Small business
- Diverse suppliers
- Values-based shopping
- Artisan products
- Handmade goods
- Organic and sustainable products
- Retail buying
- Home decor
- Fashion and accessories
- Food and beverage
- Beauty and skincare
- Direct-to-retailer sales

## Platform Overview

- [Faire Wholesale Marketplace](https://www.faire.com): Homepage for Faire's wholesale marketplace connecting independent retailers with brands across all product categories

## Home & Living Brands

- [The Object Enthusiast](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_13331240): Handmade ceramics, planters, and artisan home decor products
- [Par Avion Tea](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_43vj38s3): Small-batch luxury artisan tea from Northern California

## Fashion & Accessories Brands

- [GERMAINE DES PRES](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_245pb84qhp): French organic cotton lingerie and intimate apparel designed by Pascale Gransagnes
- [Below Houston](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_2rc1cfud): Designer handbags and fashion accessories brand
- [MAVIS BY HERRERA](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_2zb7ybpys4): Sustainable handbags crafted from recycled materials
- [Charix](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_30ismbhogt): Handcrafted Turkish leather footwear from Istanbul
- [Shaka Brands](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_34sbtfprv6): Hawaiian apparel and custom clothing from Hawaii

## Beauty & Skincare Brands

- [CLMD Sensitive Skincare](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_2oqvtzogp6): Hypoallergenic skincare featuring TrueLipids and TrueCider product lines
- [Sister Bees LLC](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_3qiu738fk1): Natural beeswax skincare products from Michigan

## Food & Beverage Brands

- [Biscuiterie Les Sablés d'Asnelles](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_2r6mayr4he): French shortbread biscuits made with AOP butter
- [GRIA Food Co.](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_3dbtmx656v): Organic fairtrade cashew snacks from African-owned brand
- [Liquid Alchemist Syrups](https://www.faire.com/brand/b_49bm149wq6): Premium cocktail syrups and beverage products
